import json,subprocess
r = subprocess.run(['php','-n','-r','\$f = get_extension_funcs(\"zlib\"); sort(\$f); echo implode(\"\\n\", \$f);'], capture_output=True, text=True)
z = set(l.strip() for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip())
d=json.load(open('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/scripts/docs/builtin_registry.json'))
items = d if isinstance(d,list) else list(d.values())
have = {b['canonical_name'] for b in items if (b.get('aot') or {}).get('supported')}
print(f'{len(z & have)}/{len(z)} zlib functions now declared')
print('still missing:', sorted(z - have))
